## Context / RCA
Hapuku change 2852 had two Gerrit Verified failures on the same patchset revision that passed unchanged on retry. Failure evidence:

- run 34281406317 ubuntu lanes failed in `tests/unit/test_ci_workflow_parity.py::test_sweep_extra_parity_would_have_caught_c57057f41` because the test ran `git show c57057f41:.github/workflows/_build-and-test.yml` inside a shallow Gerrit patchset checkout where that historical commit was absent.
- run 34282833154 macOS py3.13 failed the module-size gate with `could not fetch main to verify the module-size limit lock; failing closed`.

The first class has since been partially fixed on main by vendoring the historical c57057f41 workflow fixture. The remaining same-class trusted-main fetch defect is the module-size limit lock: a single transient GitHub fetch failure makes Verified fail closed even though the absolute module-size cap still runs locally against the patchset tree.

## Plan
1. Preserve the fail-closed semantics for real module-size limit drift: if trusted main is fetched and `.github/module-size-limit.txt` differs, the gate must still fail.
2. Make transient trusted-main transport failures deterministic by adding an in-step bounded retry loop to the existing Module-size gate fetch, using the same explicit GitHub URL and existing `refs/remotes/gh-main` destination. The final failed attempt remains fail-closed.
3. Add RED coverage in `tests/unit/test_ci_workflow_parity.py` that parses the real Module-size gate shell from `_build-and-test.yml` and proves it retries the trusted-main fetch before the existing fail-closed error path.
4. Keep the existing vendored c57057f41 fixture contract as the regression guard for shallow-checkout historical workflow parity.
5. Verify with targeted tests and full `make verify PYTEST_WORKERS=2`, then land through Gerrit.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] `test_sweep_extra_parity_would_have_caught_c57057f41` no longer depends on the historical commit being present in the runner's shallow checkout.
- [ ] The Module-size gate retries transient trusted-main fetch failures before failing closed.
- [ ] The Module-size gate still fails closed if all trusted-main fetch attempts fail.
- [ ] The Module-size gate still fails when the fetched trusted-main limit differs from the patchset limit.
- [ ] The trusted-main fetch continues to use the explicit `https://github.com/${{ github.repository }}` URL, not an assumed `origin` remote.
- [ ] Targeted workflow-parity tests pass.
- [ ] `make verify PYTEST_WORKERS=2` passes before Gerrit review.
